department: Registration Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
what_it_is: The Encumbrance Certificate (EC) is given by the Registration Department. You can search and view it free on the TNREGINET site, or get it at an e-Sevai centre.
how_to_apply: Go to tnreginet.gov.in and use 'Search and View Encumbrance Certificate'. Viewing the EC there is free. You can also ask at an e-Sevai centre.
where_to_apply: Online at tnreginet.gov.in (also the TNREGINET mobile app), or any e-Sevai centre.
fee: Free to view on TNREGINET. At e-Sevai: Rs 10 service charge to issue an EC, or Rs 2 per page to download.
helpline: Registration Department complaints: 9498452110, 9498452120, 9498452130. Software help: toll-free 1800 102 5174.
